name: update_task
description: Update an existing task's title or description. The task must belong to the authenticated user. At least one field (title or description) must be provided.

task_id.description: UUID of the task to update (required)

description.description: New task description (optional). Maximum 2000 characters. Can be set to empty string to clear description.

success.description: Whether the task was updated successfully

input.description: Discuss weekend plans, birthday gift ideas, and vacation dates

errors.condition: Task ID not found or belongs to another user

response.message: At least one field (title or description) must be provided
Task title must be under 500 characters
